notes: Inbound from content-marketing platform demo signup (marketing blog + email templates).
High-volume, short prompts: typical request ~150-400 tokens; often batch-run for nightly drafts.
Cost is primary gating factor — wants to understand per-token economics and caching possibilities.
Interested in Hosted API first (self-serve) — wants quick onboarding and predictable billing.
Key asks on call: batching options, KV/prefix caching, streaming vs non-streaming cost tradeoffs.
Quote from onboarding call: 'We need to run thousands of short generations overnight — latency ok if queued but cost must be < $0.002 per generation average.'
Model preference: smaller/quantized open models preferred; fallback to larger models for edge cases only.
Security: currently no strict residency requirement. SOC2 would be nice but not blocker; audit logs/KMS for future roadmap.
Technical note: uses a microservice architecture on AWS, multi-tenant app, will call Redwood from background workers (no user PII in requests today).
Contact prefers Slack for fast questions; also available by email.
timeline: 2026-02-20: Self-serve signup via marketing landing page, trial credits automatically provisioned.
2026-02-23: First discovery call (Maya + Rafael). High-level requirements and volume sketch.
2026-03-02: Sent security FAQ; customer returned targeted questions about audit logs and token retention.
2026-03-04: Perf spike test scheduled (customer to run batch job against test endpoint).
2026-03-09: Demo of batching & prefix-caching features with sample config; customer asked for sample cost calc templates.
next_step: Share templated cost-model (batching + caching) + set up a 1-week trial with increased token quota. Schedule 30-min technical deep-dive with SE.
blockers: Worried about token cost at scale — needs clear example calculations.
Legal/finance wants a simple estimate before expanding trial quota.
Unsure whether Hosted API throttles will support background batch window (need burst policies clarified).
notes_summary: SMB inbound, marketing/content-gen platform. Wants Hosted API self-serve. High volume, cost-sensitive; interested in batching/caching. No immediate residency requirement. Next: provide cost model + extended trial, technical deep-dive with SE.
freeform_extra: Suggested SE agenda: 1) batching param examples (max_batch_tokens, timeout) 2) sample caching strategies (prefix cache, KV usage) 3) fallback routing basics 4) cost calculator walkthrough.
Potential expansion path: move to Dedicated if consistent throughput and data isolation needed in 6-12 months.
